create_idefics_causal_lm_model: create an IdeficsCausalLM instance to load a vision-language model for text generation with image support
build_idefics_batch_from_processor: build an IdeficsCausalLMBatch from protobuf requests using an AutoProcessor to handle multimodal inputs
generate_token_idefics: generate the next token for a batch of IdeficsCausalLM requests with vision and text inputs
filter_idefics_batch: filter an IdeficsCausalLMBatch to remove completed requests and keep only active generations
concatenate_idefics_batches: concatenate multiple IdeficsCausalLMBatch instances into a single batch for efficient processing
